nodes.description: Owner address state variable in Owned; set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor and read by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address in Owned; set by transferOwnership and consumed/reset by acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol 'VGR' set once in the Voyager constructor.
Public token name 'Voyager' set once in the Voyager constructor.
Public token decimals set to 2 in the Voyager constructor.
Total token supply (35000000000) assigned in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
mapping(address => uint) of token balances; written by transfer/transferFrom/constructor and read by balanceOf/totalSupply.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowance store; written by approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom and read by allowance.
Caller-supplied address used as balance key, allowance key, ownership check and callback argument.
SafeMath.safeAdd: c = a + b followed by require(c >= a) overflow guard.
SafeMath.safeSub: require(b <= a) then c = a - b; used for balance and allowance decreases.
SafeMath.safeMul: c = a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv: require(b > 0) then c = a / b.
ERC20 totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
ERC20 balanceOf(address): returns balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 allowance(address,address): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
ERC20 transfer(address,uint): decrements sender balance with safeSub and increments recipient balance with safeAdd, then emits Transfer.
ERC20 approve(address,uint): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens with no zero-first protection (documented double-spend caveat).
ERC20 transferFrom(address,address,uint): safeSub on balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], safeAdd on balances[to].
Owned constructor: owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner (two-step transfer).
Requires msg.sender == newOwner, emits OwnershipTransferred, promotes newOwner to owner and clears newOwner.
Voyager constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals/_totalSupply and pre-funds the deployer address with the whole supply.
Sets allowance then calls attacker-controlled spender contract via receiveApproval, forwarding msg.sender, tokens, this and data.
Payable fallback function that immediately reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner rescue function performing an unchecked external ERC20 transfer(owner, tokens) to the owner.
Integer addition c = a + b protected only by require(c >= a).
Integer subtraction c = a - b protected by require(b <= a) using caller-influenced balances/allowances.
Integer multiplication c = a * b with division-based overflow check.
Integer division c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0).
External, attacker-supplied call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed while allowance is already written; enables callback/reentrancy.
Unchecked external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an owner-supplied contract address.
Parameter a of safeAdd; first operand of the addition.
Parameter b of safeAdd; second operand of the addition.
Parameter a of safeSub; minuend of the subtraction.
Parameter b of safeSub; subtrahend of the subtraction.
Parameter a of safeMul; left factor.
Parameter b of safeMul; right factor.
Parameter a of safeDiv; dividend.
Parameter b of safeDiv; divisor guarded by require(b > 0).
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf used as the balances mapping key.
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance used as the outer allowed mapping key.
Parameter spender of allowance used as the inner allowed mapping key.
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Token amount parameter of transfer; operand of safeSub/safeAdd on balances.
Spender address parameter of approve; inner key of the allowed mapping.
Allowance amount parameter of approve; value written into allowed.
Debit account parameter of transferFrom.
Credit account parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom; operand of safeSub/safeAdd.
Candidate owner address parameter stored into newOwner.
Spender contract address parameter; also the target of the external receiveApproval call.
Allowance amount parameter of approveAndCall, also forwarded to receiveApproval.
Arbitrary bytes parameter forwarded unvalidated to the spender contract callback.
Owner-supplied token contract address used as the target of the unchecked external transfer call.
Amount parameter of transferAnyERC20Token forwarded to the external token transfer.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the balances mapping key in transfer.
msg.sender is the outer key of allowed[msg.sender][spender] in approve.
msg.sender is the inner key allowed[from][msg.sender] debited in transferFrom.
Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before promoting the owner.
msg.sender is written into allowed and forwarded to the spender callback in approveAndCall.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership with require(msg.sender == owner).
onlyOwner modifier gates transferAnyERC20Token with require(msg.sender == owner).
acceptOwnership is gated by require(msg.sender == newOwner).
Owned constructor writes the privileged owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the privileged newOwner staging variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
safeAdd performs the guarded addition c = a + b.
safeSub performs the subtraction c = a - b under require(b <= a).
safeMul performs the guarded multiplication c = a * b.
safeDiv performs the guarded division c = a / b.
transfer calls safeSub to debit balances[msg.sender].
transfer calls safeAdd to credit balances[to].
transferFrom calls safeSub on balances[from] and on allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit balances[to].
transfer writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom writes the balances mapping for from and to.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] without checking the allowance was exceeded.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] without zeroing the previous allowance.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
Voyager constructor initializes _totalSupply.
Voyager constructor pre-funds balances of the fixed deployer address.
Voyager constructor sets the symbol state variable.
Voyager constructor sets the name state variable.
Voyager constructor sets the decimals state variable.
approveAndCall invokes the external attacker-controlled receiveApproval after writing the allowance.
The spender contract callback can re-enter approveAndCall before the call returns.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes an external ERC20 transfer on an owner-supplied address.
The external token contract returns control to transferAnyERC20Token; its return value is not checked.
transferAnyERC20Token uses owner as the external transfer recipient.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before invoking the external call.
msg.sender is the single untrusted entry point reused across all externally callable functions; self-reference records that reuse.
